senses.gloss: pr. n.Tsemaḥ, allegorical name of the future Messiah.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>צ׳ שמו</he> his name is Ts. (by ref. to <cite ref="Zechariah 6:12">Zech. VI, 12</cite>).

<cite ref="Zechariah 6:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הוא צ׳ הוא מנחם</he> the numerical value of the letters <cite ref="R00567"><he>צמח</he></cite> is the same as that of the letters of <he>מנהם</he> (138); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>.
